title: Garage form flow
description: Scaffold a routed, multi-step form flow library and register it with an app.

name.x-prompt: What is the name of the form flow (e.g. vehicle-registration)?

steps.description: Comma-separated data-entry steps. A review step is always appended.
steps.x-prompt: Which steps should the flow have (comma-separated, e.g. owner,vehicle,documents)?

title.description: Title shown above the stepper. Defaults to the name in Title Case.

directory.description: Parent folder for the new library.

app.description: App whose app.routes.ts gets the new route. Pass an empty string to skip.

route.description: URL segment for the flow. Defaults to the kebab-case name.

e2e.description: Generate a Playwright spec in the app's e2e project.

skipFormat.description: Skip running Prettier on generated files.
